source_text: Psychological sequelae, empirically linked to the trauma of the procedure and its lifelong repercussions, encompass post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), anxiety, depression, and somatic disorders, with studies reporting higher prevalence among FGM survivors compared to uncircumcised peers, independent of socioeconomic confounders.
